# Headspace

> A comprehensive mental health and wellness platform offering meditation, sleep support, therapy, and AI-powered mental health tools for stress relief and mindfulness.

Headspace is a leading digital mental health company providing guided meditations, sleep resources, online therapy with licensed therapists, AI-powered coaching (Ebb), and mindfulness programs for individuals and families. The platform integrates evidence-based techniques including CBT and ACT with accessible wellness content.

## Key Topics

- Meditation
- Mindfulness
- Mental Health
- Sleep Support
- Stress Management
- Anxiety Management
- Guided Meditations
- Online Therapy
- CBT (Cognitive Behavioral Therapy)
- AI Companion (Ebb)
- Sleep Music
- Mental Wellness
- Stress Relief
- Meditation App
- Sleep Wellness

## Core Products & Services

- [Headspace Homepage](https://www.headspace.com): Headspace homepage showcasing meditation, sleep, and mental health app
- [Mental Wellness App: Meditation & Sleep](https://www.headspace.com/app): Main app product page featuring meditation, mindfulness, and sleep features
- [Online Therapy & Counseling](https://www.headspace.com/online-therapy): Headspace online therapy service with licensed therapists and insurance
- [Meet Ebb | AI Mental Health Companion](https://www.headspace.com/ai-mental-health-companion): Ebb AI companion for mental health support and stress management

## Meditation & Mindfulness

- [Guided Meditation App and Resources](https://www.headspace.com/meditation): Core meditation content library with guided meditations and courses
- [Mindfulness App: Exercises, Activities, and Resources](https://www.headspace.com/mindfulness): Mindfulness exercises, breathing techniques, and wellness resources
- [Beginning Meditation](https://www.headspace.com/content/topics/93): Beginner meditation guide with fundamental techniques and breathwork
- [Courses and Singles](https://www.headspace.com/content/topics/58): Meditation course catalog and guided meditation library index
- [New and Popular](https://www.headspace.com/content/topics/100): Featured meditations and new releases from Headspace content team

## Sleep & Rest

- [Online Sleep Meditation Resources and Sleep App](https://www.headspace.com/sleep): Sleep meditation library with sleepcasts, sleep music, and sleep hygiene
- [Relaxing Sleep Music](https://www.headspace.com/content/topics/175): Sleep music collection with calming tracks and ambient soundscapes
- [White Noise and Sleep Sounds](https://www.headspace.com/content/topics/176): White noise and ambient sounds for sleep, relaxation, and focus

## Mental Health & Wellness

- [Mental Health and Wellness Resources and App](https://www.headspace.com/mental-health): Mental health hub with articles, courses, and wellness resources
- [Reduce Anxiety with Headspace | CBT & Anxiety App](https://www.headspace.com/mental-health/anxiety): Anxiety reduction program with CBT courses and guided meditations
- [Stress & Anxiety](https://www.headspace.com/mental-health/stress): Stress management resources with mindfulness and CBT-based tools
- [Guided Meditations for Anxiety](https://www.headspace.com/content/topics/107): Anxiety-focused guided meditations with in-the-moment support
- [Online Mental Health and Wellness Coaching](https://www.headspace.com/coaching): Text-based mental health coaching with CBT and ACT-based guidance

## Specialized Programs

- [Mindful Families](https://www.headspace.com/app/mindful-families): Family mindfulness content including parenting and kids meditation
- [Becoming a Mindful Parent](https://www.headspace.com/content/topics/167): Mindful parenting guide with emotional intelligence and family wellness
- [Mindfulness at Work](https://www.headspace.com/content/topics/166): Workplace mindfulness and stress management for professional wellness
